name: Lockheed Martin UK Ampthill
summary: Lockheed Martin UK's Ampthill business in Bedfordshire, described as an engineering centre of excellence with over 20,000 sq ft of advanced manufacturing space.
how_to_apply: Apprenticeships are advertised on the Lockheed Martin UK early careers page: search the vacancies, upload a CV and complete the coversheet. Most positions require HM Government security clearance.
